mapper.select: SELECT id, device_id, product_type_id, product_type_code, source_mapping_id, resolution_status, source_version, source_updated_at, effective_from, effective_to, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id FROM ast_device_current_product_type WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND device_id = #{query.deviceId} AND current_marker = 1 AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ast_device_current_product_type SET effective_to = #{update.effectiveTo}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{update.tenantId} AND device_id = #{update.deviceId} AND current_marker = 1 AND deleted = b'0'
